precision: BF16 autocast, FP32 parameters and AdamW states
training_loss: native asinh-space 2-pinball; no labels in frozen cache
selection: minimum validation raw-scale equal-channel scaled2pinball; earliest step then recipe index; all8 dataset-arm selections sealed before E arrays opened
primary: raw-scale equal-channel scaled2pinball, quantiles sorted for scoring; native loss also reported
pass: both datasets: selected query step>0 and beats F0; E loss<=1.01 selected standard; query real training-step peak<=0.80 selected standard; E loss<=0.995 min(selected head,selected side)
memory_measurement: full forward + cache generation + loss backward + clipping + optimizer.step; allocated/reserved; no cross-window persistent cache; complete fitting wall time includes validation and checkpoint copies
smoke: FP32 initial query versus F0 relative L2<=1e-5 and max_abs<=1e-4; BF16 relative<=0.02; nonzero B-gradient, parameter update and forecast effect; no trainable past graph; group isolation and missing-key mask checks
stop: minimum implementation checks then16 fixed fits; no gradient approximation gate; no second seed, more recipes, or fixed-memory batch experiment unless the fixed-batch quality/resource gate passes; no independent holdout claim
gpu: 30s startup idle with no external compute PID, free>=4GiB, utilization<=20%; every<=5s at step boundaries monitor free/used/util/PIDs; pause if external compute or free<1GiB; existing per-step memory guard; never kill external jobs
